subject: Processor inventory for DPA amendment + transfer mapping
messages:
From: Laura Simmons <laura@finsys.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Miguel Torres <m.torres@finsys.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: full processor roster + DPA amendment for audit

Hi Monica,

We’re gearing up for a compliance review in Q1 and need a consolidated processor roster that maps where FinSys data (PII + transaction telemetry) is processed and stored. Specifically: 
- Complete list of subprocessors (product/service + country) active in the last 12 months
- Data paths for EU-origin traffic (any cross-border flows to US or other jurisdictions)
- Any processors that have access to transient logs or raw request/kv caches

We also need a proposed DPA amendment to reflect two items: 1) explicit subprocessor notice for log/metrics processors, and 2) confirmation of export controls and encryption-in-transit for cross-border transfers. Can you provide the roster as a CSV (template attached would be ideal) and a draft amendment/DocuSign readiness so our legal team can review?

Timebox: is 5 business days reasonable? Our audit window is Jan 18–22 and counsel would like to start redlining by Jan 8.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Laura Simmons
Head of Compliance, FinSys
laura@finsys.com
+44 20 7946 0123

P.S. We’ve attached the audit scope (see Drive link) for context.

Monica — attaching the completed processor_inventory_template.csv and a short summary of items that need callouts. Attachment: processor_inventory_template.csv (CSV, 14KB)

Key findings (summary):
- New EU-region caching provider: EdgeRoute Ltd (Ireland) — handles edge caching & prefix KV caching for EU traffic; has access to short-lived KV cache; qualifies as a processor that can access transient request metadata.
- Longstanding metrics vendor: PulseMetrics (US) — receives aggregated telemetry; no PII in the feed, but receives request metadata; operates in US infra (requires cross-border transfer mechanism).
- Temporary log processor used during a migration window: CloudCache Inc. (US) — retained May–Jul 2026 for migration; had access to raw logs for 6 weeks (we already rotated keys and executed deletion).
- KMS/HSM provider: KeyVault Partners (DE region available) — used for customer-managed keys on Private deployments; confirm if FinSys requires CA/attestation.

CSV excerpt (first 3 rows):
"ProcessorName,ServiceCategory,PrimaryCountry,AccessType,ActiveFrom,ActiveTo,Notes"
"EdgeRoute Ltd,Edge cache,IE,KV cache / prefix cache,2026-05-01,active,short-lived cache access (TTL<48h)"
"CloudCache Inc,Log retention/ingest,US,raw logs,2026-05-01,2026-07-15,temporary for migration; deletion verified"

I’ve also attached a redwood DPA draft we typically share for notice changes (redwood_dpa_draft_2026-11-29.pdf). It includes an exhibit template for listing processors and a standard transfer mechanism section we can populate.

Next: Karthik, can you confirm the TLS and key management details for EdgeRoute and CloudCache, and whether PulseMetrics receives identifiable telemetry?

—Vanessa

Laura / Miguel — thanks for the request and for the timeline. Please find our consolidated response below and the two attachments referenced.

What we’ve provided (attachments):
- processor_inventory_template.csv — complete roster with country, access type, and activity windows (see EdgeRoute and CloudCache notes)
- redwood_dpa_draft_2026-11-29.pdf — short DPA amendment draft with an Exhibit A processors table prefilled and a transfer-mechanism section.

Summary highlights:
- EdgeRoute Ltd (IE): edge caching / KV cache; access to short-lived KV entries (TTL under 48 hours). Located in Ireland; no cross-border transfer to the US for EU-region traffic unless a customer chooses a US-region Dedicated/Private deployment.
- CloudCache Inc. (US): temporary log processor used May–Jul 2026 for migration; raw logs were deleted and we have verification (deletion confirmation and change-control notes included in CSV notes column).
- PulseMetrics (US): receives aggregated telemetry; we do not include PII in the pipeline by default, but request-level metadata is present. We recommend a standard SCC/Binding corporate rules transfer mechanism and have included language in the draft amendment.
- KeyVault Partners: KMS available in DE region; we can offer DE-hosted key material for customers requiring EU residency.

Next steps:
1) Please review the attached DPA amendment draft and processor exhibit. If FinSys wants modifications, flag line items in the DocuSign link here: https://app.docusign.com/FinSys-DPA-2026
2) If you need a vendor attestation pack (deletion proofs, SOC snippets), Vanessa can pull certificates and evidence within 48 hours.
3) We propose a 5-business-day review window; if counsel needs faster turnaround, let us know and we’ll prioritize.
